groups.sentence: Instructors may choose not to require documentation or acknowledgement of AI use and are not expected to catalog incidental uses.
Instructors may restrict basic AI features only when they are central to what the assignment assesses.
Instructors state which conventional tools, accessibility features, or exceptions are not counted as AI or remain permitted.
Instructors resist using basic generative AI functions such as spelling and grammar assistants.
Students may use basic spell-check and grammar-check tools built into word processors while writing.
Students need not disclose or document routine uses such as spell-check, grammar correction, or embedded AI features.
Routine or incidental AI use is common practice, outside the policy's intent, and needs no documentation or acknowledgement.
Basic spelling and grammar tools are generally not counted as generative AI under the rules.
Everyone need not disclose AI embedded in larger software or used for minor, routine tasks like grammar editing.
